info.title: VietFul API
info.description:
# INTRODUCTION

VietFul API is a RESTful API that caters for creation of OR or IR resource and also actions like getting the other data such as Address, Product...

For your convenience, other common API endpoints are also documented here.

post.description:
How does it work?

- When VietFul receives request from Partner, it will do some basic validations and if data is valid,
it will accept this request, put it to queue then send response back to Partner with ID and Code generated by VietFul.

- Partner's system should capture this data for later reference.

- When order processed (successful or not, for some reasons such as not enough stock, not supported shipping service...),
VietFul will send result to Partner via Webhook.

oauth2.description:
## Request a new OAuth Bearer Access Token

**Parameter**

| Field         | Type   | Description                                                                    |
| ------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| host			| String | On Momena Portal - Developver Settings - "Authentication" Field.                          |
| realm         | String | Client Code (first three character of the link which you are provided to login)|
| grant_type    | String | Allowed value: `client_credentials`                                            |
| client_id     | String | On Momena Portal - Developver Settings - "Client ID" Field                     |
| client_secret | String | On Momena Portal - Developver Settings - "Client Secret" Field                 |

**Sample Request**

```
POST /auth/realms/aad/protocol/openid-connect/token HTTP/1.1
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Host: auth.stg.vnfai.com
grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=foo&client_secret=9a7691a6-3838-418e-abe9-5aa59d5892f8
```

With

| Field         | Value                                  |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------- |
| realm         | `aad`                                  |
| grant_type    | `client_credentials`                   |
| client_id     | `foo`                                  |
| client_secret | `9a7691a6-3838-418e-abe9-5aa59d5892f8` |

**Success 200**

| Field              | Type   | Description                                                  |
| ------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| access_token       | String | Token used with every request sent to VietFul API.           |
| expires_in         | Number | `access_token` expiration in `second`                        |
| refresh_token      | String | Used for `access_token` refreshing. This token will be INVALID when `refresh_expires_in` passes. |
| refresh_expires_in | String | `refresh_expires_in` expiration in `second`                  |
| token_type         | String | Allowed values: `bearer`                                     |

*Success Response Sample*

```
HTTP/1.1  200 OK
{
  "access_token":  "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsInR5cCIgOiAiSldUIiwia2lkIiA6ICJVbWx4dlNkUkxmc0JPTTRVQTlmQ1NDaHVFblZBaExFU1l3SDR5OGc5UjlnIn0..C7iKjDOEm5olu57ZBl3hjCFrICaysE3TeSovKy4wJwdNqH3mFVPLip3LJBvFvT3p9WeZzHM4liZiR1Yzyg4Sd1SsPG0LgffhmlYqyZqd6ghb1lzwXT37rmzNrHDyqSm-QB6Y_YOP_ypKzCaDgW8nUZc2K8jSF7VyELUOwkTMvMkIuMVlgO-efZjPRaWsrIRJoAGhmIUfAAh56IkS6GLA8kNPiD29m0fjJ3TL7tfgMv2RUoifkwTXbhzVwEF0dKfyfZ4Rjdp2CcA55Dc1MKS9M_Yo9MYQMvzwhbyQ9UgZkeUgdM03WTWYhJE5gw9tUOU-r-LwQH8hBi0-qiOx0PnQmg",
```

tags.name: Webhook
tags.description:
- Webhook is a tool to support the system in sending messages to the partner's system when an event occurs (for example: An order is created, packaged or handed over to the shipping partner). ...)

* Partner systems can register to monitor one or more different events.
* When an event that the partner system registered to monitor occurs, the system will send (POST) HTTP Request to the declared endpoint of the partner system.


- If the response received has a Status Code **other than 2xx**, the system will try again after 15 minutes.



1. **Request**

   1.1 **Authenticate Request**

   - Each request coming from the system includes a Header with the key `x-vf-hmacsha256`

   ```
   x-vf-hmacsha256 M+g/E2xu2ROm+KeEHFM8LR9HnV0pcNKpmInn0+rg/+M=
   ```

   - The value of this key is the hash result according to the `HMACSHA256` algorithm of `body` (request) and `client_secret` (provided by VietFul), then converted to Base64. Below is sample C# code.

   ```
   public string ComputeHash(string body, string clientSecret)
   {
       var encoding = new UTF8Encoding();
       var textBytes = encoding.GetBytes(body);
       var keyBytes = encoding.GetBytes(clientSecret);
   
       byte[] hashBytes;
   
       using (var hash = new HMACSHA256(keyBytes))
       {
       	hashBytes = hash.ComputeHash(textBytes);
       }
   
       return Convert.ToBase64String(hashBytes);
   }
   ```

   - To validate the request is valid, the partner system will calculate the hash similar to above, then compare it with the value of `x-vf-hmacsha256` and the Request is considered valid when the results are the same.

   1.2 **Structure of Request**

	- The body of each request has the following common values:
	 - **id**: Id of the request, used for debugging when problems arise.
	 - **timestamp**: Sending time, calculated in seconds with the mark being 0:00 on January 1, 1970 (UTC).
	 - **event**: Event name/type.
	 - **errorCode**: Error code (if any).
	 - **errorMessage**: Error interpretation (if any).



2. **Events are being supported**

   | **Event code**        | **Descrption**                                                    |
   | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
   | IR_PROCESSING_STARTED | When the inbound request (or IR) began to be processed. |
   | IR_FINISHED           | When the inbound request (or IR) was completed. |
   | OR_CREATING_COMPLETED | When the system finishes validating outbound request (OR), it will returns the result. The result may indicates the OR creation is successful or NOT. |
   | OR_PROCESSING_STARTED | When the order began to be processed.                             |
   | OR_PICKED             | When the order had been picked.                                |
   | OR_PACKED             | When the order had been packaged.                                |
   | OR_SHIPPED            | When the order had been handed over to the shipping partner.            |
   | OR_DELIVERED          | When the shipping partner successfully delivered the goods.               |
   | OR_DELAY              | When the shipping partner reported the delay/failure of the delivery.   |
   | OR_PARTIALRETURNED    | When the order had been partially returned.                               |
   | OR_RETURNED           | When the return of the order had been completed.                         |
   | OR_CANCELLED          | When the order was cancelled.|
   | INV_CHANGED           | When the inventory of the product changed.                                 |

2.1 **IR_PROCESSING_STARTED**

- Occurs when the warehouse operation begins processing IR.

- Body:

  ```json
  {
    "irId": 269,
    "irCode": "IRHAREXDE662",
    "partnerIRCode": "IRHAREXDE662",
    "warehouseCode": "TNA",
    "actualArrivalDate": 1618384359,
    "processingDate": 1620113345,
    "event": "IR_PROCESSING_STARTED",
    "id": "8fbc5ea6-a742-45e5-8a78-1f17df807de1",
    "timestamp": 1620113350
  }
  ```

| Attribute    | Value                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| irId              | ID of the IR (Inbound Request)            |
| irCode            | Code of the IR         |
| partnerIRCode     | Code of Partner of this IR                      |
| actualArrivalDate | Actual Arrival Date                     |
| processingDate    | The time when warehouse staff start to process the IR|

2.2 **IR_FINISHED**

- Occurs when warehouse operation confirms IR “Completed”.

- Body:

  ```json
  {
    "irId": 269,
    "irCode": "IRHAREXDE662",
    "partnerIRCode": "IRHAREXDE662",
    "warehouseCode": "TNA",
    "actualArrivalDate": 1618384359,
    "finishedDate": 1620113345,
    "event": "IR_FINISHED",
    "id": "8fbc5ea6-a742-45e5-8a78-1f17df807de1",
    "timestamp": 1620113350
  }
  ```

| Attribute    | Value                              |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------- |
| irId              | ID of the IR (Inbound Request)            |
| irCode            | Code of the IR         |
| partnerIRCode     | Code of Partner of the IR                      |
| actualArrivalDate | Actual Arrival Date                     |
| finishedDate      | The time when warehouse staff finish processing the IR   |



2.3 **Event related to outbound order status**

- List of events

| **Event code**        | **Description****                                                    |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| OR_CREATING_COMPLETED | When the system finishes validating outbound request (OR), it will returns the result. The result may indicates the OR creation is successful or NOT. |
| OR_PROCESSING_STARTED | When the order began to be processed.                             |
| OR_PICKED             | When the order had been picked.                                |
| OR_PACKED             | When the order had been packaged.                                |
| OR_SHIPPED            | When the order had been handed over to the shipping partner.            |
| OR_DELIVERED          | When the shipping partner successfully delivered the goods.               |
| OR_DELAY              | When the shipping partner reported the delay/failure of the delivery.   |
| OR_PARTIALRETURNED    | When the order had been partially returned.                               |
| OR_RETURNED           | When the return of the order had been completed.                         |
| OR_CANCELLED          | When the order was cancelled.|
| INV_CHANGED           | When the inventory of the product changed.                                 |

  ```
  {
    "orId": 20107,
    "partnerORCode": "TVCTEST0001",
    "event": "OR_CREATING_COMPLETED",
    "id": "ae2c1c84-e5e6-456f-9092-e61f70c7eab4",
    "timestamp": 1620113536
  }
  ```

- Fail response:

  ```
    "partnerORCode": "TVCTEST0001",
    "errorCode": "shipping_service_not_sppor_biz_type_format",
    "errorMessage": "Shipping packages are not supported for B2B orders.",
  ```


2.4 **Event related to inventory change**

- List of events

| **Event code**        | **Description**                                                    |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| INV_CHANGED           | When the inventory of the product changed.                                 |

- Reponse of event **INV_CHANGED**:

  ```
  {
    "event": "INV_CHANGED",
    "id": "ae2c1c84-e5e6-456f-9092-e61f70c7eab4",
    "timestamp": 1620113536,
    "warehouseCode": "TTNC",
    "changedReason": "PRODUCT_UNIT_CONVERTED",
    "items": [
        {
            "unitCode": "CAI",
            "sku": "string",
            "partnerSKU": "NB002",
            "conditionTypeCode": "NEW",

        }
    ]

  ```

- Values of attribute: **changedReason**

| OR_CANCELLATION_COMPLETED  | Cancel OR successful                  |
| PRODUCT_UNIT_CONVERTED     | Product's unit changed     |
| CONDITION_CONVERTED        | Product's condition changed     |
